scenario_title: Release-train cascade down the dependency chain
title: Elevated 5xx errors on api-gateway
impact: A share of requests failed with 5xx on api-gateway
symptom: [ANOMALY] api-gateway 2026-03-19 16:39-20:19: api-gateway: 229 of 296 log lines were non-INFO between 2026-03-19 16:39 and 2026-03-19 20:19 UTC (peak error ratio 1.0 vs baseline median 0.0). 1 error templates, 0 first seen in this span. Peak p95 latency 0.518 s vs baseline band up to 0.245 s.

_templates.macro: Release train {cycle} shipped FEAT-132 (Usage dashboards API) across services; the {svc} part ({version_to}) broke, and the failure surfaced in {alert_svc} through the dependency chain. The later parts of the same feature were harmless.
_templates.micro: {file}:{line} ({symbol}) fetches every invoice with all its lines for the usage API.
_templates.remediation: Roll back {svc} {version_to} -> {version_from} (the other services' parts of FEAT-132 can stay); fix {file}:{line}; add a cross-service load test to the train.

rca.macro: Release train RT-26.12 shipped FEAT-132 (Usage dashboards API) across services; the billing-svc part (v4.5.0) broke, and the failure surfaced in api-gateway through the dependency chain. The later parts of the same feature were harmless.
rca.micro: billing/repo/InvoiceRepository.java:25 (InvoiceRepository.findOpenByAccount) fetches every invoice with all its lines for the usage API.
rca.remediation: Roll back billing-svc v4.5.0 -> v4.4.1 (the other services' parts of FEAT-132 can stay); fix billing/repo/InvoiceRepository.java:25; add a cross-service load test to the train.

action_items: Add a regression test covering InvoiceRepository.findOpenByAccount (billing/repo/InvoiceRepository.java).
Alert on the error signature `GET <*> <*> <*> target=billing-svc`.
